facts.fact: 插页遗页：第五层让人互相防备、为影子争斗；作者悔于把 Marble 留下等死，如今自己卡在缝里只能祈祷有人找到他。
facts.anchor: The Fifth is where we started turning against each other. The depth, the darkness, it makes you paranoid, makes you . . . Now that I’ve mad it back to the Third, I realize we were fighting each other over shadows. But down there, it felt so real. I’m sorry, Marble. If I hadn’t left you to die, you could be here to help me out of this crevice now. I’ll just have to pray that someone finds me.

facts.fact: 从第四层游到第五层岸上后，她的腿撑不住体重，全身泡得发白起皱。
facts.anchor: my legs shake from not being used to holding my weight. Every inch of me has gone all pruned. I can’t even remember what it’s like to be dry.

facts.fact: Petra 招出 mindripper 对她说的话：她拖住 Jade、其实不懂医学，整人一袋废物。
facts.anchor: “It said”⁠—I draw in a shaking breath⁠—“that I hold you back and don’t really know anything about medicine,” I mumble. “Basically, I’m just a big sack of shit.”

facts.fact: 她信不过 Jade 的安慰——那些话不是编的，是从真相里抽出来的。
facts.anchor: The mindripper didn’t invent those words out of nothing. It pulled them from the truth.

facts.fact: sun mushrooms 发出黄光让第五层不用头灯；六肢兔与松鼠在吃草，一切像地表。
facts.anchor: Giant bulbous fungi producing yellow light, called “sun mushrooms,” grow out of the walls and ceiling. Fluffy six-limbed rabbits and squirrels graze on patches of grass. A deer with giant ears runs by, and it has big brown eyes like a surface one. The trees even look like regular trees, except the bark is black and the leaves a little too unnaturally green. Squint hard enough and you can almost forget you’re in the Void.

facts.fact: 这片叫 Last Paradise：太像地表，潜水员因此放松、忘掉危险。
facts.anchor: That’s why this area is called Last Paradise. It looks so much like the surface and is such a reprieve after the hell it takes to get here that divers get comfortable. They forget about the danger.

facts.fact: 五尺高的血瓶草盆口如水槽，内壁分泌像血的液体诱捕小兽；比图鉴的三尺记录更大，她想替下版勘误。
facts.anchor: Five-foot-tall blood pitcher plants grow out of the ground, their rimmed opening as wide as a kitchen sink. I stand on my toes and peer inside of one. Jellyflies and a couple dead unrecognizable mammalian creatures are in there, dissolving in soupy carnage. The walls of the blood pitcher’s interior produce fluid that looks and smells metallic, just like blood, which draws small predators for it to trap and feed on. This thing is bigger than I read about in The Field Guide of Void Botany, which lists the recorded size of the biggest blood pitchers as three feet tall. Maybe these plants have evolved since the author was down here. I make a mental note to suggest some updates for the next edition.

facts.fact: sanaroot 长在血瓶草旁，据说有极强的镇痛、抗菌、凝血之效；她挖出一颗拳头大的块茎。
facts.anchor: Sanaroot grows near blood pitchers, and those roots are supposed to have outstanding pain-reducing, antibacterial, and coagulation effects.

facts.fact: 剥皮、开膛、取肛门齿、煮过头才敢吃；营养糊像温热的鼻涕，同伴却像吃冰淇淋一样吞光。
facts.anchor: After skinning, gutting, removing the anal teeth, and overcooking the moss rat, we finally sit down to eat our meal. Our main dish looks like a slab of well-done leather, but with enough salt, the moss rat is delicious. Or maybe I’m just starving. The nutrient paste is brown sludge with the consistency of warm snot and the flavor of raisins that have spent a few days too many in the sun. I’m worried Jade and Flint will hate it and me for having made it, but they gobble it down like it’s ice cream. I’m relieved, proud even.

facts.fact: 第五格跳到一小时，累计下层时长七十四小时；她不停眨眼防自己睡过去。
facts.anchor: I yawn, noticing the number on the fifth gauge of my tracker roll over to one hour. The gauge counting my total time down here says seventy-four hours. I blink a few times to keep my eyes from closing.

facts.fact: Flint 的埋藏点旁是一块刻满前人缩写名的巨石，他问要不要把名字刻上去。
facts.anchor: It’s covered with initials, the marks of divers who’ve made it this far. He stands to the left of the boulder and counts ten steps, then taps his foot on the ground. “Here.”

facts.fact: Flint 平静地说出他与弟弟此行的目标：杀掉害死他们母亲的那只怪物。
facts.anchor: “The monster that killed our mother,” he deadpans.

facts.fact: Flint 接受同行帮忙：surfacewalker 曾是人、至今仍有一部分是人，所以聪明，而聪明又邪恶的人最难对付。
facts.anchor: “I would appreciate that,” he says. “Because even though it might not be as strong as other monsters we’ve faced, these things were human once⁠—technically, are still part human⁠—so they’re smart. And that’s the worst thing to be up against⁠—a smart, evil human.”

facts.fact: Jade 当众纠正她：别这么轻易把两人的帮忙送出去，生存需要自私。
facts.anchor: Jade huffs. “Don’t offer our help so lightly, Pet. Survival requires selfishness.”
when their spores are inhaled, they can cause vivid hallucinations and paranoia that lasts for days. Part of me thinks that makes the flowers worth studying

facts.fact: 黑而冷的左边、开满温暖 sun mushrooms 的右边；Flint 兄弟原定走左边。
facts.anchor: It’s darker in that direction. A chilly wind blows over my skin, causing goose bumps. The path to the right is brighter, blooming with warm, inviting sun mushrooms.

facts.fact: Flint 一脚踩穿地面，声音升到她从未听过的恐慌八度，泥土在他脚下急速崩塌。
facts.anchor: “Shit⁠—” His voice hits a panicked octave that I haven’t heard from him before. “Shit, shit⁠—” He scrambles backward, arms flailing, but the earth’s rapidly crumbling beneath his feet.

facts.fact: 她抓住 Flint 的背包往上拖，Jade 从后面抱住她猛拉，Flint 从她手里滑脱坠下。
facts.anchor: I grasp Flint by his bag, heaving him toward me. I have him⁠—I just have to get his feet back on solid land. But Jade’s arms scoop under mine, and she yanks me with such force, Flint slips through my hands.

facts.fact: Jade 反驳：地面当时也在 Petra 脚下塌，她救的是 Petra 的命。
facts.anchor: “You were going to fall down there too. The ground’s unstable.” Jade grabs my hand, pulling me toward the way we came. “We need to go back⁠—”

facts.fact: Petra 试拽树根、把绳绕树打结，宣布自己下去拉 Flint，让 Jade 在上面拉绳。
facts.anchor: But he needs us. “We’re going to climb out.” I tug on some gnarled tree roots to test their sturdiness. They’re good. I weave the rope into a knot around the tree. “You stay up here and pull us out.”

facts.fact: 她冲 Jade 喊出理由：第三层那次失踪，是 Flint 帮她把人救回来。
facts.anchor: “When I lost you in the Third, he helped me save you. Don’t you have any compassion?”

facts.fact: 她承认自己一向听 Jade，因为 Jade 通常总是对的——可这次不是。
facts.anchor: I always do what she says because, normally, Jade is always right.

facts.fact: 洞底到处都是尸体，扭曲成一堆堆血肉。
facts.anchor: There are bodies.
